title: oxalis metcalfei
intro: Oxalis metcalfei, commonly known as the Wood Sorrel of the Andes, is a plant species native to the tropical regions of South America. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, and its health benefits include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, which may help to protect against oxidative stress, inflammation, and infections. The therapeutic actions of Oxalis metcalfei include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial actions, which may help to soothe skin irritations, wounds, and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
